name: Mohini
note: Suspended: an avatar with no ancestry, floated beside the churning of the ocean

Mohini.note: The thirteenth of the avatars, and the only one in the form of a woman: she took the nectar from the asuras by charm alone and served it to the devas, which is the whole reason Rahu and Ketu, both here, are two halves of one severed body. SB 1.3.17, 8.8-9
